name: Ashton & Reyes Mag-Heel Oxford
description:
A dress oxford with a discreet ferromagnetic heel plate, designed for augmented professionals who work in secure corporate environments with maglock flooring. The shoe itself is impeccable — burnished synthetic cordovan, a sleek silhouette, double-stitched welt. Nothing about it reads as industrial or modified. The mag-heel is invisible from the outside.

Worn in Tier 4 boardrooms and Tier 3 office floors alike. The idea is that you look composed and formal while being able to operate in any environment your chrome legs need to navigate.
functionality: Concealed ferromagnetic heel plate provides maglock compatibility. Invisible from exterior. Compatible with standard industrial and corporate-grade maglocked flooring.
what_it_says: You're polished, augmented, and neither of those things is anyone's business unless you choose to make it so.
worn_by: security consultants who dress for boardrooms
story_hooks: The mag-heel frequency is calibrated to a specific corporate client's flooring spec — wearing them in a rival facility could flag you on their security grid.
A pair was found at a crime scene with the heel plate surgically removed — someone needed the ferromagnetic component for something else entirely.

physical_description.visual_profile: A refined, traditional dress oxford with an understated corporate aesthetic. Sleek and elongated silhouette that reads as high-end professional footwear at first glance. The wearer appears grounded and authoritative, moving with subtle stability even on ferromagnetic flooring.
physical_description.fit: Tailored and precise around the foot, with a structured toe box and snug heel counter. Designed for ergonomic stability whether the wearer has biological feet or augmented limbs. The profile is slim without being restrictive.
physical_description.primary_material: Burnished synthetic cordovan with a mirror-polished finish. Durable, weather-resistant composite underlayer. Ferromagnetic alloy heel plate embedded within the heel structure itself.
physical_description.texture: Glossy, supple surface with a subtle grain reminiscent of genuine leather. The welt stitching is crisp and visible, emphasizing craftsmanship. Heel plate is imperceptible to touch from the exterior.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep cordovan burgundy with charcoal gray accent stitching. Polished chrome ferrule at the heel tip. Interior leather lining in neutral tan.
physical_description.closures: Traditional lace-up with hidden magnetic closures beneath the tongue—quick-release for augmented users who need rapid footwear changes.
distinctive_features: Invisible ferromagnetic heel plate for maglock floor anchoring
Double-stitched welt construction signaling haute couture quality
Dual-purpose design: formal aesthetics with tactical functionality
Reinforced insole with haptic feedback integration points for augmented limbs
Ashton & Reyes maker's mark stamped discretely on inner heel
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 crossover luxury. Priced as Tier 2 corporate status symbol, accessible to high-earning Tier 3 professionals.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by augmented corporate operatives, board-level employees with visible cybernetics, and security professionals who need invisible tech integration. Signals competence, discretion, and access to secure environments. The wearer is someone who belongs in both chrome and marble.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new, developing a distinguished burnish and micro-scuffs with age. Polished regularly to maintain the cordovan sheen. Well-maintained leather shows subtle creasing around the vamp.

The shoe gleams under cool, directional lighting that highlights the burnished cordovan finish and precise stitching. Urban corporate backdrop—glass and steel office environment or maglock flooring detail visible. Shallow depth of field emphasizing the refined heel and welt construction.
